name: zotero
description: Search, read, annotate, and manage your Zotero library: add papers by DOI, arXiv ID, or ISBN, highlight PDFs, export BibTeX.

library_id.title: Zotero library ID
library_id.description: Your numeric user ID from https://www.zotero.org/settings/keys (or a group ID).

api_key.title: Zotero API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://www.zotero.org/settings/keys (allow write access to add items).

library_type.title: Library type
library_type.description: Default library: your personal library (user) or a group.

unpaywall_email.title: Email for open-access PDF lookup (optional)
unpaywall_email.description: Lets DOI imports attach open-access PDFs via Unpaywall; also used as the CrossRef contact.

webdav_url.title: WebDAV URL (optional)
webdav_url.description: Only if Zotero syncs files via WebDAV, e.g. https://nas.example:5006 (without /zotero).
